ITEM 1 | Pale golden-tan cubed or wedge-shaped pieces with lightly browned edges and a few small dark green flecks, firm and holding shape, roughly 2-3 cm pieces, clustered on the left-center of the plate | 150
ITEM 2 | Small dark reddish-brown wrinkled pieces, likely dried and chewy-looking, about 1 cm each, three or four scattered among the pale pieces on the upper left | 8
ITEM 3 | Orange sliced rounds, glossy and slightly moist with a smooth surface, cut into thin half-moon slices about 0.5 cm thick, fanned out on the upper right side of the plate | 90
ITEM 4 | Dark purple-brown cubes with charred or browned spots and a glossy, slightly oily sheen, about 2 cm pieces, mixed with pale golden-green pieces at the lower right | 85
ITEM 5 | Pale yellow-green cubes with lightly browned, slightly crisp edges and a dry surface, about 1.5-2 cm, mixed among the dark purple pieces at the lower right | 45
